input.command: cd D:\pal; foreach ($p in 5173,8080) { try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://127.0.0.1:$p/" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 20; "port $p => HTTP $($r.StatusCode), bytes $($r.RawContentLength), title=$((if ($r.Content -match '<title>(.*?)</title>') { $matches[1] } else { 'n/a' }))" } catch { "port $p => ERR $($_.Exception.Message)" } }
